# agentsmd

agentsmd is a CI gate that fails when an AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules,
etc.) starts lying: it statically verifies that every referenced path, script
and version still exists in the repository.

- What it checks: drift/missing-path, drift/missing-script,
  drift/version-mismatch, bloat/token-budget, bloat/readme-duplication.
- It never executes repository content. Verification is static only.
- It does not generate or rewrite instruction files; it detects drift.
- Output: human-readable text or SARIF 2.1.0. Exit 1 on any error-level finding.

## Usage

- GitHub Action: `- uses: ofershap/agentsmd@v0.1.0`
- CLI: `go install github.com/ofershap/agentsmd@v0.1.0 && agentsmd check`
- Flags: -root, -file, -format (text|sarif), -budget (token budget, bytes/4)
